name: Zed
summary: Add TablePro as a context server in Zed's agent panel to query your databases.
description:
Add TablePro to Zed's context servers with the path to the tablepro-mcp bridge inside the app. Zed's agent can then list connections, read schemas, run queries and write data, within what each connection allows external clients to do.

The Connect a Client sheet in TablePro's settings shows the steps.

disclosures.accessNote: The bundled bridge uses a Read & write token. Each connection's External Clients level and Safe Mode still apply.
disclosures.networkNote: Zed sends query results to the language model provider you set up.
